subject: Spec: Position tracker full spec (audit doc + 2 enhancements)
body:
## Current Implementation (verified exam.html)

### State Machine: Position Tracker

States:
- IDLE: No question visible. Tracker shows '--' or is empty.
- TRACKING: Question N is visible. Tracker shows 'QN of [total]'.

Transitions:
- IDLE -> TRACKING: IntersectionObserver fires when any question enters viewport
- TRACKING -> TRACKING: User scrolls, new question becomes most-visible
- TRACKING -> IDLE: No question in viewport (edge case: scroll past all questions)

### Current Display: 'Q1 of [total]'
### Current Implementation: IntersectionObserver (correct approach)
### aria-live='polite' confirmed (PASS)
### aria-label='Question position' confirmed (PASS)

## Status: MOSTLY PASS. Two enhancements needed.

## Enhancement 1: Show answered state in tracker (medium)

Current tracker just shows 'Q7 of 15'. Add answered indicator:
- 'Q7 of 15 • 6 done'
- Shows momentum and progress without leaving the question view

Visual:
```
Q7 of 15 • 6 done
```

Copy:
- '• N done' where N is number of answered questions so far
- When all done: '• All done!' (triggers before scorecard)

ariaLabel: 'Question 7 of 15. 6 questions answered.'

## Enhancement 2: Completion celebration micro-moment (low)

When last question answered and tracker shows 'All done!':
- Tracker background briefly flashes `var(--color-correct)` for 200ms
- prefers-reduced-motion: no flash

## Acceptance Criteria
1. '• N done' count appended to tracker text after first question answered
2. aria-label updated to 'Question N of 15. M questions answered.'
3. When all answered: '• All done!'
4. Flash on all-done completion (with reduced-motion guard)
5. IntersectionObserver logic unchanged

## What NOT to change
- 'QN of [total]' core format
- Sticky position of tracker
- aria-live='polite' (correct, don't change to 'assertive')

## Priority: Medium (Enhancement 1) / Low (Enhancement 2)

## Scope
- exam.html: updateTracker() function (add answered count)
- exam.html: check() function (update answered counter on correct submission)
- shared/styles.css: tracker flash keyframe (low, Enhancement 2)

## Related
- sw-05: Position tracker spec (this doc)
- da-09: Position tracker audit PASS (format confirmed)
- .design-system.md Section 1b (ADHD: progress always visible)
